title: Well-Being at Work: Sustainable Pace and Meaningful Work
before: Work in human services matters, and it can wear people down.

turns.text: The work you do matters to the people you serve. To keep doing it well, you need a pace you can sustain. This course isn't about adding self-care to your to-do list. It's about noticing what you need, and knowing where to get support.

guidance.text: Well-being is partly personal and partly about how work is set up. Both deserve attention.
Have you noticed any of these signs lately? You don't need to share. Just notice.
If any part of this course feels heavy, pause. Support is available, and you can come back when you're ready.
